_what_this_is: ADR-003 Action Item 7 result: real-Ollama latency comparison between the old ReAct loop (_run_agent_react_loop) and the new Orchestrator (_run_agent_orchestrator) in calai_backend/services/agent_service.py. Produced by evals/latency_comparison.py, which prints to stdout and does not persist a file itself — this JSON is a transcription of that run's output, captured by the sdlc-orchestrator/reviewer stage that executed it, so the numbers are preserved as a durable artifact instead of living only in an agent report.

run_context.note: Single-run timing against a live local model, not a statistical study (see script docstring point 4) — treat as one representative data point, not a distribution.

correctness_side_finding.description: On the profile_only message, the old ReAct loop's LLM-computed TDEE diverged sharply from the orchestrator's deterministic CalcPipeline result, on identical input.
correctness_side_finding.interpretation: Evidence the split fixes a real correctness gap (the old loop let the LLM re-derive arithmetic it was only supposed to sequence), not just a latency win.
